decisions.reason: For an invariant orthonormal Ricci eigenframe, D_k Ric_ij=(lambda_i-lambda_j) Gamma^j_ki determines all connection coefficients. Torsion-freeness then determines invariant-frame brackets. The homogeneity assumption makes their components constant, and the reciprocal algebra has the same isomorphism class.
